name: Europe hybrid attacks
summary: Drones closed Jersey airport two nights running; Romania blames Russia for ship sinking
state: Drones closed Jersey airspace on the nights of 30 and 31 Oct, diverting flights; officials reviewed the response on 1 Nov and no operator had been identified. Russia's emergencies ministry said its public alert app was hit by a large cyberattack overnight into 2 Nov. Romania blamed Russia after a drone sank a ship in the Black Sea on 23 Oct.
for_you: Drone sightings can cause short-notice flight delays and diversions. Check with your airline before travelling.
rubric_hit: Drone incursions closed an airport; attack attributed to a state
